\section[votar]{votar — to vote}

\label{lesson:ES-C507-votar}



\begin{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: votar}
\textbf{votar} — \textquotedblleft{}to vote\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}

\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Tomorrow we vote at the local school.}
\end{quote}
